parsedVerdict.reasoning: PlaceOrderUseCase is an application-layer file, so it should orchestrate: load aggregates, call domain services, persist, and map to DTOs. It also carries inventory business rules that belong in the domain layer. It defines the stock-sufficiency rule (product.stock >= quantity) inline. It mutates product stock directly (product.stock -= item.quantity) after the domain service call. It also sets the initial order state 'placed' itself. The domain already has an OrderDomainService with reserveStock, so the stock invariant is split across the two layers. The DTO mapping, repository calls and error propagation are legitimate application work.
